title: Have a Nice Death

notes: Magic Design Studios' 2D action roguelike, published by Arc Games in 2023. Reported perfect on a base M1 with macOS 15.7.7 and DXMT on the Wine 11 engine r31 over 218 minutes at 1440x900.
